title: I think I was kicked out of mall world

classification.question_topic: Dreamer reports recurring 'mall world' dreams that stopped after learning about the phenomenon; asks if others experienced this and speculates about liminal space.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene described (no locations visited, sensory details, events, or spatial layout). Only frequency/recurrence metadata and a generic description of a 'fancy mall with quirks'.

meta.author_theory: Speculates they may have stopped because their subconscious won't let them; wonders if it is a liminal space.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to recurrence/frequency and a generic place label ('fancy mall with a bunch of quirks') with no extractable sensory qualifiers (light, cleanliness, crowding), no discrete locations, and no events.
